tokens.name: red-600
tokens.usage: Spark Red 600. Primary fills (buttons, badges, the active tab rule) in both themes, and red text on light surfaces. Never text on dark surfaces (3.1:1).

tokens.name: red-400
tokens.usage: Red 400. Red text, icons and focus rings on dark surfaces (5.1:1 on ink-900, 4.6:1 on ink-800).

tokens.name: red-700
tokens.usage: Red 700. Hover and pressed state of red-600 fills.

tokens.name: red-50
tokens.usage: Red 50. Tinted blocks on light surfaces; behind red-600 text (5.5:1).

tokens.name: danger-fill
tokens.usage: Danger fill (UX Phase 3: Tailwind red-600, the kit's danger button). Confirm buttons that delete; white text (4.8:1).

tokens.name: danger-fill-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of danger-fill (Tailwind red-700).

tokens.name: ink-950
tokens.usage: Ink 950 (Black). Primary text on light; app frame and sidebar in the dark theme.

tokens.name: ink-900
tokens.usage: Ink 900. App frame and sidebar in the light theme; main pane in the dark theme.

tokens.name: ink-800
tokens.usage: Ink 800. Sidebar hover; raised surfaces (menus, modals) in the dark theme.

tokens.name: ink-700
tokens.usage: Ink 700. Active sidebar item; borders in the dark theme.

tokens.name: ink-600
tokens.usage: Ink 600. Secondary text on light surfaces, including ink-100 (7.5:1).

tokens.name: ink-500
tokens.usage: Ink 500. Muted text on white and ink-50 only (fails on ink-100); strong borders in the dark theme.

tokens.name: ink-400
tokens.usage: Ink 400. Muted text on dark; input borders on light (3.4:1 on white).

tokens.name: ink-300
tokens.usage: Ink 300. Sidebar item text; secondary text in the dark theme.

tokens.name: ink-200
tokens.usage: Ink 200. Hairlines and dividers on light surfaces.

tokens.name: ink-100
tokens.usage: Ink 100. Primary text in the dark theme; neutral chips on light.

tokens.name: ink-50
tokens.usage: Ink 50. Row hover and sunken areas on light surfaces.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: White. Main pane on light; text on red-600 and on the dark sidebar's active item.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success. Presence (active) dot and success toasts; white text on it is 5.0:1. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning. Fills only, with on-warning text (6.6:1). Never warning-coloured text.

tokens.name: on-warning
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a warning fill.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error. Same as Spark Red (red-400 in dark, as accent, for 4.5:1); always with an alert icon and a plain-language message.

tokens.name: app-frame
tokens.usage: The dark frame behind the sidebar. The main pane sits on it as a rounded card inset by space-2.

tokens.name: sidebar-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered sidebar items.

tokens.name: sidebar-active
tokens.usage: The current channel, DM or page in the sidebar.

tokens.name: sidebar-text
tokens.usage: Read channels and DMs, Work and Manage items (9.1:1 on app-frame light, 9.6:1 dark, 8.3:1 on sidebar-hover).

tokens.name: sidebar-text-strong
tokens.usage: Unread channel names (with weight 600) and the active item's label.

tokens.name: sidebar-text-muted
tokens.usage: Section labels (CHANNELS), muted channels (5.5:1 on app-frame).

tokens.name: sidebar-accent
tokens.usage: The active item's icon and the starred icon in the sidebar (3.9:1 on sidebar-active).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Main pane, thread panel and composer background.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered message rows, menu items and list rows.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the message toolbar, modals and toasts. Pair with a shadow token.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Code blocks, file cards, the composer's attachment tray and search inputs.

tokens.name: surface-selected
tokens.usage: The message whose thread is open, or that a link or search result jumped to. Fades out 2s after a jump. Product addition (amber tint of warning).

tokens.name: surface-mention
tokens.usage: Rows that mention the current user, and the current user's own reaction chips. Dark value is a product addition (red-400 text on it is 4.7:1).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: header and tab bottoms, dividers, card and menu borders.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and the composer, which identify a control (3.4:1 light, 3.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Message bodies, author names, headings on surface, surface-hover, surface-selected and surface-mention.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Channel topic, descriptions, menu shortcuts, system messages (7.5:1 or more on every surface).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Timestamps, placeholders, counts. On surface and surface-hover only (4.7:1 light on hover, 5.0:1 dark on raised).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Red as text or an icon: links, 'N replies', mention pills, destructive menu items.

tokens.name: accent-fill
tokens.usage: Red as a fill: the primary button, the enabled Send button, mention badges, the active tab rule.

tokens.name: accent-fill-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of accent-fill.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent-fill (6.4:1).

tokens.name: presence-active
tokens.usage: The 'active' presence dot (3.7:1 on the sidebar, 5.0:1 on white).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring colour; used by the focus-ring shadow.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind modals and the mobile drawer.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Channel intro heading at the beginning of history. One per view.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Channel name in the header, thread panel title, section headings in panels.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: NEX-104 is on staging. p95 fell from 1.8 s to 62 ms.
styles.usage: Message bodies and long text. Readex runs wide: 14px reads like Slack's 15px.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Author names; unread channel names in the sidebar; emphasis in bodies.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Sidebar items, menu items, inputs, list rows.

styles.name: ui-medium
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, the selected item of a segmented control.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Thread summaries, file subtitles, helper text, the typing indicator.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Timestamps, counts in chips, captions. The minimum size.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels (set text-transform: uppercase), echoing the SYSTEMS line of the logo. English only: never track Arabic.

styles.name: body-ar
styles.sample: تمت إضافة الفهرس على بيئة الاختبار.
styles.usage: Message bodies when dir=rtl or the text is Arabic (line height 1.8).

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline code, code blocks, snippet previews, ticket keys (NEX-104).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside chips; reaction chip vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between toolbar buttons; message row vertical padding; menu padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Avatar-to-text gap in a message; menu item horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Sidebar horizontal padding; card padding; composer inner padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Message list and header horizontal padding; modal padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between sections in panels and modals.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Outer padding of full-page empty states.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inline code, kbd hints, small (20px) avatars, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, icon buttons, menu items, sidebar items, 36px avatars, file cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The main pane card, composer, menus, popovers, modals, toasts, the message toolbar.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Presence dots, count badges, reaction chips, the date-divider pill.

tokens.name: shadow-toolbar
tokens.usage: The floating message toolbar and the date-divider pill.

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, autocomplete, the emoji picker, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-modal
tokens.usage: Modals and the call window.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every interactive element: a 2px gap in the surface colour, then a solid 2px red ring (6.4:1 light, 5.1:1 dark). On the sidebar use the dark value in both themes.

tokens.name: size-avatar
tokens.usage: Message avatars.

tokens.name: size-avatar-sm
tokens.usage: Sidebar DMs, thread-summary facepiles, member chips.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Icon buttons, composer and toolbar buttons, sidebar item height (28px rows plus 4px gap).

tokens.name: size-input
tokens.usage: Buttons with labels, text inputs, the search box.

tokens.name: size-topbar
tokens.usage: The top bar at the top of the main pane: sidebar toggle, search, notifications, profile.

tokens.name: size-header
tokens.usage: Channel header row.

tokens.name: size-tabs
tokens.usage: Channel tabs row.

tokens.name: size-sidebar
tokens.usage: Default sidebar width; resizable 200–420px.

tokens.name: size-panel
tokens.usage: Thread, file details and channel details panels; resizable 360–640px.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky date dividers and the jump pill.

tokens.name: z-toolbar
tokens.usage: The message hover toolbar.

tokens.name: z-menu
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, autocomplete, the emoji picker.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Modals and their scrim.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts.
